full_judgment:
Amirul Kabir Chowdhury J: -Accused petitioner Mahabubul Goni seeks leave to appeal against the judgment and order dated 21.03.2004 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 2250 of 2002 discharging the rule. 

 3. Being aggrieved the accused petitioner filed Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 2250 of 2002 under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure. A Division Bench after hearing the parties discharged the rule. Hence is this petition. 

 4. In support of the petition Dr. Rafiqur Rahman, learned Senior Advocate submits, inter alia, that the accused petitioner having 75% share in the company the remedy of the respondent No. 2 (complainant) lies in Company Court and as such the proceeding against the petitioner is an abuse of process of the court and that the learned Magistrate failed to understand the order dated 25.07.2001 of the High Court Division passed in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 1693 of 2001 and thus framed charge on 03.12.2001 under section 397 of the Companies Act illegally and that there being no ingredients of any offence punishable under section 397 of the Act, the proceeding against the petitioner is an abuse of process of the court and that the High Court Division committed error in not considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances.
